name: facet-filter
description: One filter group in a category listing. Material, drill diameter and 'age from' filter the products live; other facets show as collapsed static headers.

view.name: FacetFilter
view.notes: Rendered by the listing's client component (not standalone). Interactive facets (material -> product.material, drill_diameter -> product.drill_diameters, age_from -> product.age_from): options = the datasource entries, each with a live count from the folder's products; zero-count options disabled. Sidebar layout: accordion head 16/300 (chevron), checkbox rows 'label (count)' 16/300, gap 12, multi-select (OR within facet, AND across facets), first 6 options visible + 'mehr anzeigen'. Top-bar layout: label 16/600 then inline radio chips 149x44 bg var(--color-panel) (single-select, no counts). Static facets: header only, never expands (no values on source when collapsed).
